classification.difficultyReason: Calculate weekly wages, convert them to annual wages, calculate a percentage bonus and combine the amounts.

content.prompt: Amy is paid \$23.50 per hour and works a normal 35-hour week. At the end of the year her employer pays her a bonus of 5% of her yearly wages. Calculate Amy’s total annual pay.

answer.worked:
Using 52 weeks in a year:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Weekly wages} &= 23.50 \times 35 \\ &= \$822.50 \\ \text{Yearly wages} &= 822.50 \times 52 \\ &= \$42\,770 \\ \text{Bonus} &= 42\,770 \times 0.05 \\ &= \$2138.50 \\ \text{Total annual pay} &= 42\,770 + 2138.50 \\ &= \$44\,908.50\end{align*}$$
